name: Four Seasons Hotel Sydney
positioning: Harbourside hotel in The Rocks historic precinct of Sydney, just metres from Circular Quay
best_for: Travelers who want a base just metres from Circular Quay
Guests who want a 10-minute walk to the Sydney Opera House

facts.text: The hotel has 531 rooms and suites.
The hotel is at 199 George Street, Sydney.
The hotel is set in the harbourside The Rocks historic precinct of Sydney, just metres from Circular Quay.
The hotel was built in 1982 on the site of a former colonial jail.
The hotel's restaurant is Mode Kitchen & Bar.
The hotel's lounge is Grain Bar.
The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool with a separate whirlpool.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours.
The fitness centre also features a sauna and steam room.
The hotel's art collection has more than 100 works.
Children's menus are among the hotel's amenities for kids.

highlights.text: The Sydney Opera House is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
60 percent of rooms enjoy views of the Bridge or Opera House.
Guests staying in a Club Room, Club Suite or Signature Suite have access to Lounge 32 on level 32.
Premium Wi-Fi is listed among the hotel's complimentary services.

considerations.text: The spa is open daily from 10:00 am to 6:00 pm.
Kingsford-Smith International Airport is 30 to 45 minutes by car from the hotel.
Guests not staying in a Club Room, Club Suite or Signature Suite can purchase Lounge 32 access for an additional fee per person per night.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
